## Implementation

Every post starts with an empty `Underwriter` that loads the shared knowledge
base, so canonical assumptions are available by name (see README.md).

```{python}
from aggregate import Underwriter, qd
import pandas as pd

uw = Underwriter(databases=None)     # start empty
uw.load('example_library.agg')       # shared assumptions, resolved from project root

a = uw.build('''
agg <Name>
    <frequency clause>
    <severity clause>          # or reference a shared object: sev.<Shared>
    <reinsurance / aggregate clauses>
''')
qd(a)
```

## Reproduction

Published values versus aggregate, side by side. Transcribe the paper's numbers
into `published`; aggregate's land beside them. Comparison is visual — no asserts.

```{python}
published = pd.Series(
    {'<stat 1>': 0.0, '<stat 2>': 0.0},   # <-- paper's values
    name='published')

computed = pd.Series(
    {'<stat 1>': a.<...>, '<stat 2>': a.<...>},
    name='aggregate')

cmp = pd.concat([published, computed], axis=1)
cmp['error'] = cmp['aggregate'] / cmp['published'] - 1
qd(cmp, accuracy=5)
```

State the result plainly — e.g. "These match the values in the paper."
